name: standard_em_procurement
description: A substantive fixed award notice covers ordinary urban-rail signalling replacement without an innovative core.

candidates.title: Metro awards conventional signalling replacement package
candidates.search_snippet: The metro awarded a contract to replace ageing signalling equipment on an existing line.
candidates.source_content: Synthetic procurement notice. The metro operator awarded a contract for conventional replacement of ageing signalling equipment on an existing line. The notice states the package, contractor, delivery milestones, and that the contract amount is not disclosed; it does not describe a new technology, material, method, pilot, or trial.

contract_notes: Procurement is the core value, so the primary category is 機電標案.
